newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico May maquiladora production rises 13.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico May maquiladora production rises 13.3 pct.

text.p: Production in Mexico's maquiladora industry grew 13.3 percent in May compared with the same period last year, the national statistics institute INEGI said on Tuesday.
The maquiladora, or in-bond, industry is comprised of assembly plants mainly along the U.S. border.
INEGI said cumulative production for the year rose 14.4 percent compared with the first five months of 1996.
Employment in the industry grew 20.8 percent compared with May 1996, while hours worked increased by 12.2 percent. ((--Caroline Brothers, Mexico City newsroom +525 728 7905))
